verses.mystical_translation: A young crown placed where elders fell; a new voice rises from the dust of the slain.
A brief season, forty-two counted; a mother's house names the boy's pedigree.
Counsel of kin shapes a son's path; the mother's voice pulls the scepter toward Ahab's road.
Evil repeated in a house's pattern; counsel after a father's death brings ruin.
Joined in a war not his alone; the brother‑kings meet the blows of the north.
Wounds carry him back to Jezreel; a kinsman journeys to the bed of the sick.
A meeting ordained; the anointed instrument arrives and the old house is set to fall.
Judgment sweeps beyond one house; attendants and kin are taken with the guilty.
Hunted from hiding, killed and buried; a son's burial rests on an ancestor's piety as excuse for mercy.
A mother's grief turns to massacre; the royal seed is cut down to seize the land.
A hidden child preserved: a daughter of the king shields the seed in a priestly house.
Six years of concealment in the sanctuary while a usurper wears the crown.

contemplative_note: A throne set amid blood — note how kingship, counsel, and divine judgment intersect, leaving hidden hope in a preserved child.
safety_note: Contains graphic dynastic violence and executions; use responsibly in scholarly contexts.
